name: Woodworking workbench
summary: Maple workbench, 1.8 x 0.6 m: butcher-block top with dog holes, front vise with wooden chop, laminated legs with through tenons, lower shelf with offcuts.
parts: 70 mm laminated maple butcher-block top, edge-glued strips with staggered butt joints and end grain at the ends
row of square dog holes along the front with one bench dog raised
front face vise: maple chop with leather liner, steel screw with thread, two guide rods, cast hub and sliding steel handle bar
front and back aprons under the top
upper and lower end rails, lower ones with wedged through tenons
long stretchers bench-bolted through the legs
lower shelf of ripped pine boards nailed to the rails
offcuts on the shelf (2x4 miter drop, 1x6, walnut scrap, plywood corner) and a little sawdust
style: Well-used but cared-for traditional maple workbench, oiled top, light dents, sawdust on the shelf.
notes: Size includes the raised bench dog (y 0.89) and the vise hub and handle in front (z 0.66 at rest).
